description: Get the event's draft timetable: scheduled sessions grouped by day and room in time order, plus a separate items list of breaks, plenums, and blockers. Use it to read or show the schedule; optionally limit to one day (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns days[] (rooms[] with sessions[]), items[] with kind and day, and truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: get_agenda

days.description: Scheduled sessions grouped by day, then room.

day.description: Day, YYYY-MM-DD in the event timezone.

roomName.description: Room name, or 'All rooms' for plenary rows.

items.description: Breaks, plenums, and blockers in time order.

kind.description: Agenda item kind, e.g. break or plenum.

roomName.description: Room name, or 'All rooms' for plenary rows.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
